message.content: {"note_claim": "Lifepack is a real Colombian company that makes products from agricultural waste such as pineapple (the note also claims small-scale production and a specific process, which this page does not describe).", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Muchos campesinos se benefician al vender a Lifepack su residuo agrícola (maíz, piña, arroz, etc) , que antes generaba problemas de contaminación o simplemente era desechado.", "reason": "The page confirms Lifepack is a real Colombian company that transforms pineapple and other agricultural waste into packaging, but it says nothing about the crushing, mixing, sun-drying and pressing process, the low scale, or the video not being genuine."}
